title: SwiftUI State, Architecture, and Application Flow
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of swiftui state, architecture, and application flow in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 17: SwiftUI State, Architecture, and Application Flow. Lessons in order: State Management Fundamentals; The @State Property Wrapper; Bindings with @Binding; Observable Application Models; Observation and View Updates; Environment and Shared Dependencies; Reusable SwiftUI Components; Conditional Views and View Composition; Navigation State and Deep Linking; Sheets and Full-Screen Presentations; Lists with Editable Data; MVVM and Other App Architecture Patterns; Managing Complex App State.
